items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Roy had a beat. He was a kind man. I liked that beat he had. I liked his drumming.

ctx.x: Yeah, Bob Rand and different people you heard. I mean, either in personal or on records or anything? Radio?
Well, I had another fellow I used to like. Mm-hmm. His style was a little different, but I liked that beat he had. That was Roy Evans. Mm-hmm.
Who was he with then? Roy Evans played with Sam Morgan. Oh, yeah.
